title: How to Find Your Voice as a Poet
skills: identify qualities that contribute to a distinct poetic voice
experiment with diction, imagery, rhythm, and perspective
develop greater authenticity and consistency in poetry
revise poems to strengthen individual voice
alignment_note: Explores how poets can develop an individual voice through deliberate choices in language, imagery, rhythm, perspective, and personal expression. Supports poetry writing, stylistic experimentation, authorial voice, and revision across high school English and creative writing courses.
